title: The promise on the rooftop
note: Cue times are movie seconds. Each cue must end before its gap does (build/ad/movies/<key>/gaps.json).

cues.text: Cherry trees in full bloom fill the grounds inside the school gate.
Looking up past the iron gate, petals blow across a bright blue sky.
A gloved hand reaches up into the sky, fingers spread.
It closes slowly around a falling petal.
On the rooftop, Aigis stands at the railing, arm raised. Wind turbines turn behind her.
Eyes closed, she brings her hand down, cupped around the petal.
She opens her eyes and lowers her arm.
The hero rests his head in her lap, looking up at her.
Her eyes shine with tears.
Blossoms crowd a branch.
Wind turbines turn by the bay, the city beyond.
She lifts her gaze.
Under the stars, she grips her Evoker.
Her hand on her chest.
Her hand settles over his.
The hero looks up at her.
He raises his hand to her face and wipes away a tear.
She holds his hand against her cheek.
The two, alone on the rooftop bench.
She turns her head.
The hero's eyelids droop.
Petals stream across the sky above the school gate's iron spikes.
Cherry trees frame the school building.
The front of the school, between the gateposts, under falling petals.
His eyes close.
From behind: Aigis on the bench, the hero's head in her lap.
City towers beyond solar panels.
Blossoms, close up.
Seen from below, her face blurs and tilts.
Darkness closes in from the edges, until all is black.
A glowing blue butterfly flutters across the dark, trailing sparkles.
It drifts away.
Light returns. Far across the rooftop, the two sit on the bench.
Close on her face. She smiles softly.
Her gloved hand rests over his.
A stairwell. Bright light pours through the doors at the top.
Aigis turns her head.
In the doorway stand Mitsuru, Yukari, Akihiko, Junpei and Fuuka, with Ken and Koromaru.
Ken holds Koromaru up in his arms.
Aigis watches them, her face calm.
The picture fades to white.
